wage.definition: Wages is the money a person is paid for doing their job.

wait.definition: If you wait for someone or something, you do something (or nothing) until something else happens.
wait.sentence: Her job at the cafe was to wait at the tables.

wake.definition: If you wake up, you stop sleeping.
wake.sentence: Could you please wake Donald up?

walk.definition: If you walk, you go on foot, step by step. Walking is slower than running.
walk.sentence: No train goes to that town, so people need to walk to go there.

wall.definition: One side of a house; a high, flat part of a building.
wall.sentence: There is a wall between the two gardens.

wander.definition: When you wander around, you walk or move slowly around without a purpose.
wander.sentence: He would wander through the city streets late at night when he could not sleep.

want.definition: If you want to do something, you think you would be happier if you did it.
want.sentence: Do you want to go to the park?

war.definition: War is when armies or countries fight against each other.
war.sentence: Those two countries are always at war.

warm.definition: If something is warm, it is a nice temperature between cool and hot.
warm.sentence: It's good to come into a nice warm house on a winter's day.

warn.definition: If you warn someone about something, is to make them aware of a danger approaching.
warn.sentence: I warn you, lions are dangerous.

wash.definition: When you wash something, you clean it with water.
wash.sentence: I wash my car every day.

waste.definition: To use something for no reason, or for bad reasons or only little reasons, and after it is used no one can use it again.

watch.definition: A watch is a little clock on a person's arm near the person's hand, to measure time.
watch.sentence: The person looks at his watch and has a thought that he is late.

water.definition: Water is a clear liquid of the chemical compound H₂O that all living things need in order to live.
water.sentence: The dog drank the water from his dish.

wave.definition: A wave is the motion of water up and down.

way.definition: A way is how someone does something.
way.sentence: The committee made a good decision about which way to make the machine.

weak.definition: Weak is used to describe something that does not have a lot of strength.
weak.sentence: The child was too weak to move the boulder.

weakness.definition: Weakness is the condition of being weak.
weakness.sentence: She had become very ill, and her weakness kept her from going to the party.

wealth.definition: Wealth is when one has a lot of money. Wealth is a lot of money or a lot of things of high value like land, houses, factories, jewelry, etc.
wealth.sentence: His wealth is so great that he wears new shoes every day.

wealthy.definition: If someone is wealthy that person is rich.

wear.definition: When you wear something, you put it on your body and cover your body with it.
wear.sentence: I don't wear shoes on my feet when I am inside.

weather.definition: The weather in a place is the air temperature, the number of clouds, and the amount of wind and rain or snow.
weather.sentence: The weather conditions at the airport are bad. I don't think the plane will be able to fly.

web.definition: A web is a series of lines, ideas, or thoughts connected.
web.sentence: Her web of thoughts is complex.

website.definition: A website is a place on the World Wide Web; if there are many pages to a website, they have the same URL and are usually part of the same server.

wed.definition: When people wed they become married. Wed is an old word, most people say marry now.
wed.sentence: I'd love to be wed, but I cannot find a girl to marry me.

week.definition: A week is a period of time that lasts seven days.
week.sentence: There are seven days in one week.

weekend.definition: The end of the working week, usually Saturday and Sunday.
weekend.sentence: I do not have work on the weekend.

weekly.definition: A weekly is a magazine or newspaper that you get once a week.

weigh.definition: When you weigh something, you find out its weight.

weight.definition: The weight of something is how heavy it is.
weight.sentence: She's put on a lot of weight since she went to university.

weird.definition: Very strange or unusual. Very different from others of its kind or what is expected. Something that is weird is not at all normal.
weird.sentence: People laughed at the boy because he was weird.

welcome.definition: You say welcome as a greeting when someone arrives.

welfare.definition: Someone's welfare is their health, safety, and other things the make them happy.
welfare.sentence: Children need to exercise each day, for both their physical and psychological welfare.

well.sentence: He washed the table very well, so now it is very clean.

west.definition: The direction that the sun sets; from north, 90º to the left.

western.definition: A western place is in or from the west of the place.

wet.definition: If something is wet it has some water or other liquid on it.
wet.sentence: I got completely wet in the rain.

what.definition: Used to show that you feel strongly about something.
what.sentence: What a great book this is!

whatever.definition: One or some or every or all without specification; entity, elective existential pronoun; quantifier, elective existential.
whatever.sentence: Give me whatever peaches you don't want.

wheel.definition: A wheel is a round thing (circle) on a cart or carriage or train or other machine that moves. A cart has four wheels that touch the road and turn.

wherever.definition: Where in the world; location, singular, elective existential pronoun.

while.definition: A while is a short time.
while.sentence: After a while I will stop working and cook food for us.

whisper.definition: When you whisper to someone, you talk very quietly; to talk with breath but no voice, with a quiet sound like the wind, so only people very near can hear what you say.

white.definition: White is one of the colors people can see.

whole.definition: Whole is used to describe every part of an object.
whole.sentence: I ate the whole meal, leaving nothing left.

why.definition: Used to ask the reason for something.

wide.definition: If something is wide, it is long from one side to the other side.
wide.sentence: It's a very wide river, but not very deep.

widely.definition: If something is done widely, it is done to a great extent or a large amount; it is commonly done.
widely.sentence: The man opened his arms widely to show how big the fish was.

wife.sentence: Bill just married his second wife.

wild.definition: If an animal or plant is wild it is not tame. This means it lives in nature and people have not changed it.
wild.sentence: Wolves and bears are wild animals.

will.definition: You use will to say that you strongly expect something to happen in the future.
will.sentence: Don't worry. The sun will come up again tomorrow.

win.definition: You win when you do better than other people.

wind.sentence: The wind blows so strongly now that a person's hair goes in the person's face.

window.definition: A piece of glass in a wall to let people see through it.

wing.definition: A wing is the long flat part of a bird, insect or other flying thing. It is used to fly.
wing.sentence: He looked out the window of the plane and saw the sun shining on the wing.

winner.definition: A winner is someone that has won a competition, or often wins.

winter.definition: Winter is the coldest season of the year. In northern countries, December, January and February are winter months.
winter.sentence: We like to go to Mexico in the winter.

wipe.definition: If you wipe something, you rub it to take something off of it. Often you wipe off water or dirt.

wire.definition: A wire is a long, thin metal thing, mostly for the purpose of making a connection from electric power to a machine.
wire.sentence: A person cut the electric wire and all the machines in the building stopped.

wise.definition: A wise person has much knowledge and makes good decisions.
wise.sentence: Say your question to the old woman, because she is wise and will tell you good ideas about things to do.

wish.definition: When you wish for something, you want it and hope for it; you want it to happen.
wish.sentence: I wish I could go home now.

withdraw.definition: If you withdraw (something) from somewhere, you take (it) out.

witness.definition: A witness is somebody who saw something, especially a crime.
witness.sentence: The witness testified that Simpson was ill at the time.

woman.sentence: My wife is a good woman.

wonder.definition: If you wonder about something, you think about it because you want to know more about it.
wonder.sentence: I wonder when they will be home.

wonderful.definition: Something wonderful is exciting, excellent, and creates feelings of wonder.
wonderful.sentence: The newly discovered continent was full of strange and wonderful creatures.

wood.definition: Wood is what trees are made of. People use wood to build things like houses and furniture.

wooden.definition: A wooden object is made of wood.
wooden.sentence: Please do not spill your drink on the wooden floor.

word.definition: Words are the smallest meaningful pieces of a language that can be used on their own.
word.sentence: Class, if you are not sure on any word, be sure to check the dictionary.

work.definition: If you work, you do a job, usually for money.
work.sentence: If my computer didn't work I couldn't type this.

worker.definition: A worker is a person who works, usually for money.

world.sentence: Our world needs to be cared for.

worry.definition: Worry means to feel troubled by, anxious, or uneasy about specific problems or the possibility of unpleasant things happening in the future.

worth.definition: If x is worth y, x has the value of y, usually in money.
worth.sentence: Excuse me, how much is this ring worth?

would.definition: Would is used to show your past plan or decision.
would.sentence: He said he would be seeing Mr Moi in Bonn on Monday.

wound.definition: A wound is a cut in skin with pain and blood, a burn, or other similar mark on someone's body.
wound.sentence: I dropped a knife on my foot, but the wound was minor, so I didn't need to go to the hospital.

wrap.definition: If you wrap something you cover it with something like paper or cloth. This might be done by winding the paper or cloth over it.
wrap.sentence: We need to wrap up this meeting and get back to work.

write.definition: If you write a book, an article, a computer program, a piece of music, etc., you create it.
write.sentence: My dream is to write a children's book.

writer.definition: A writer is a person who writes books or other things that people read.
writer.sentence: She works as a writer for a magazine.

wrong.definition: If something is wrong, it is not right. If something is wrong it may be incorrect, not true, or bad.
